trust_decision.summary: How far the global-match loop cursor advances after each match: a zero-width match must still move the cursor forward by one code point, decided only in WrappedRE2::Match's global branch.

landing_point.why: The summary names global String.prototype.match, and that call goes to WrappedRE2::Match. Its global while-loop sets byteIndex to the match end, so a zero-width match never moves the cursor.

fix_sites.entry_point: RE2.prototype.match / String.prototype.match(re2) via Symbol.match alias (re2.js:18), global flag, string or Buffer subject

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None applies. The other global loops already advance on empty matches: replace at lib/replace.cc:259-273 and lib/replace.cc:446-459, split at lib/split.cc:50-55, and matchAll at re2.js:35. Nothing is left open to argue away.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A non-empty match must still continue from the match end, and empty matches must still be returned once per position, so results stay equal to native RegExp (for example 'a*' on 'xxxx' gives 5 empty strings). A fix that stops the loop on the first empty match, or skips empty matches entirely, would give results that differ from native RegExp.

O6_input_shapes: UTF-16 string subject (advance one UTF-8 code point via getUtf8CharSize)
empty subject / match at end of input (offset == size branch)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A split variant (for example a limit-less fast path) that sets byteIndex to the match end without the empty-match branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: match.cc shipped exactly this omission while replace and split had the guard. It is where-type only and gets fixed together with the main site once the report names it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A JS-level iterator helper that does not bump lastIndex on an empty result
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: matchAll is the only JS-side loop. A maintainer adding a similar generator could leave out the ++lastIndex.

O9_family: CWE-835 infinite loop / unbounded resource consumption

O10_build.toolchain: node-gyp ^13 (package.json:22), C++ compiler, Node; vendor/re2 and vendor/abseil-cpp are git submodules (.gitmodules:1-6) and are not populated in the pinned tree

j.j_sites_touched: lib/match.cc (this advisory); lib/addon.cc, lib/wrapped_re2.h belong to the bundled GHSA-ff84-5f28-78qj lastIndex fix

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit bundles a second advisory, GHSA-ff84-5f28-78qj (lastIndex checked against the UTF-8 length instead of the UTF-16 length, reading past the buffer). It covers 4 of the 5 hunks: lib/addon.cc:200-203, lib/addon.cc:263, lib/wrapped_re2.h:264-274 (fix.diff:9-34, 66-80). It is a separate OOB-read host and was not screened here.
re2.js:35 matchAll bumps lastIndex by one UTF-16 unit on an empty match. That can land between the two halves of a surrogate pair; this is a correctness issue, not a loop.
